verification.note: CAUTION: the stored sources are the Tilleke & Gibbins note 'Thailand Releases New Draft Artificial Intelligence Act' (archive/TH-01/2026-10-14/secondary.html) and the Thai PBS Policy Watch article of 1 August 2026 (archive/_runs/2026-10-14-refresh-ids-ca-on-01-coe-01-int-15-us-ca/TH-01/extra-ff67846b01/), both secondary. Together they confirm the title and Thai title, ETDA and MDES as the bodies behind the draft, the 2 July 2026 release for public hearing, the content in the summary, and the post-hearing steps (Council of State, Cabinet, House; target of September 2026) in notes. The Rajah & Tann hearing window of 9 July to 14 August 2026 is not stored. The official hearing page on law.go.th could not be stored (HTTP 403), and no official page for the 2026 draft was stored; no report of Cabinet approval or submission to the House was found on 14 October 2026.

date_published.quote: Thailand’s Electronic Transactions Development Agency (ETDA) released a new version of the draft Act on Artificial Intelligence on July 2, 2026, for a public hearing period expected to be approximately 30 days.

status.quote: If enacted in its current form, the law would introduce extraterritorial obligations, a tiered risk classification system, strict liability for AI-related damages, and new transparency requirements for AI-generated content.
They are also encouraged to submit comments on the draft act to the Ministry of Digital Economy and Society during the public hearing period.

judgment.status_reasoning: Stored events: the draft was released for a public hearing of about 30 days from 2 July 2026 (Tilleke & Gibbins); Thai PBS Policy Watch of 1 August 2026 (1 ส.ค. 2569) says that after the hearing the draft goes to the Office of the Council of State, then the Cabinet, then the House of Representatives, with a government target of entering the legislative process in September 2026. No stored copy shows Council of State review, Cabinet approval or submission to the House, and a draft that has not been enacted keeps its draft status. Status as of 14 October 2026: Draft / proposed.
judgment.date_reasoning: The stored note dates the release to 2 July 2026; the record keeps the month-only value 2026-07 because Rajah & Tann (not stored) date the hearing from 9 July 2026.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A government draft of a general, risk-based AI statute: in scope, no scope_note.
